_instructions.purpose: Use this template to create a new Regular Ride entry for regular-rides.json
howToUse: 2. Paste it into the 'events' array in regular-rides.json
3. Fill in all the fields following the guidance below
4. Remove any fields marked as OPTIONAL if not needed
5. Save regular-rides.json and rebuild the site

fieldGuide.title: The ride name as it appears in the calendar
fieldGuide.daysOfWeek: Array of day numbers: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday, 6=Saturday. Use [0] for Sunday only, [0,6] for weekends, etc.
fieldGuide.meetPoint.name: Meeting location name
fieldGuide.meetPoint.googleMapsUrl: Google Maps link to meeting point
fieldGuide.meetPoint.note: OPTIONAL - Extra info about meeting point
fieldGuide.guidance: Brief description of the ride - typical distance, terrain, pace, who it's for

newRide.title: Ride Title Here
newRide.guidance: Brief description of the ride and who it's suited for.

_exampleRide.title: Sunday Social Ride
_exampleRide.guidance: Weekly social ride. Route varies—typically 15-20 miles on towpaths and quiet lanes. All abilities welcome.
